headline: Approved minutes of May 8, 2026 meeting and reviewed Q2 2026 financial and event report for Nashua Center for the Arts.
summary: The board approved the minutes from the May 8, 2026 meeting. Spectacle Management reported on Q2 2026 events, upcoming Q3 and Q4 shows, and donations totaling $13,242.93 for the quarter to the Advancement Reserve Fund. The board also heard updates on the Sandy Cleary Gallery rotation and planning for the 2026 Arts Ball gala on October 17.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the May 8, 2026 meeting unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: MOTION: Trustee Barry moved to approve the minutes of the May 8, 2026, meeting, second by Trustee Rinaldi; it passed unanimously.
